workspaceHub.todosHint: Time- or interval-based to-dos that post into this workspace conversation.
workspaceHub.subAgentsHint: Five fixed slots: program / creative / data / assistant + Skill Agent. The first four default to idle until delegated by the main agent. With tools.skills enabled, Skill Agent stays in a monitor state and periodic audits run. Slots cannot be created or deleted. Manual runs are delegated from chat tools; this panel shows persisted run snapshots and a quick excerpt of the linked conversation.
workspaceHub.subAgentsSkillCaption: Skill audits run in the background when tools.skills is enabled; not part of main-agent delegation.
workspaceHub.subAgentsSkillCaptionToolsOff: tools.skills is off: this row is informational only. Enable skills in the workspace .agent/.tool/manifest.json to activate Skill Agent monitoring and periodic audits.
workspaceHub.subAgentsDelegateCaption: Idle by default when delegated from the main agent. Run records persist across restarts—open Details to review.
workspaceHub.subAgentsDetailsInterruptedHint: This slot was still running when the app last exited; the in-flight process cannot resume after restart—continue in chat or delegate again.
workspaceHub.subAgentsDetailsConvMissing: (Conversation not found—it may have been removed or not synced yet.)
workspaceHub.skillsHint: Future Hermes-style autonomous Skills status and evolution log will appear here.

workspaceHub.kbHint: Grounding and retrieval for this workspace (planned).
workspaceHub.kbPlaceholder: Knowledge features are coming soon: indexing, snippets, and citations will show here.

chat.starterPrompt1: Create a new folder named “docs” at the workspace root.
chat.starterPrompt2: Explain how to batch-rename all .jpg files in the current folder to names like “2026-001”, “2026-002” (script or step-by-step commands).

settings.logLevelHint_info: Standard operational messages; recommended for daily use.

ClawFlow-managed data (`.agent`, `.subagent`, `.clawflow-launcher-stash`) is stored under the app cache directory (see below), not inside this folder. Set the app cache root to this path and migrate existing `workspaces/` data?

{{path}}
